a rehearsal against the talk's length: the exact sum of every slide's rehearsed seconds less the talk's seconds, above 0 over, below 0 under; 1..999 slides of 1..3600 seconds each and a talk of 1..86400 seconds, else refused (Trebago)

where each slide (or cue) starts in a rehearsed run, in seconds from the first: the exact sum of the seconds of every slide before it, the first at 0; 1..999 slides of 1..3600 seconds each, else refused (Trebago)
the slide after slide cur (1..count) of count (1..999) in a run order: mode 0 advances and ends (0) after the last, 1 holds, 2 advances and loops back to the first; anything else refused (BASIC)
a slide fits its ^ZXFOOTLIGHT record: deck at most 9 digits, slide 4, rehearsed seconds 4, layout 1 (0 title, 1 title and text, 2 text, 3 blank), bytes 7 and stamp (ms since 1970) 15, each sign aside

what is left of a recording of length ms heard to pos ms, played at a speed rate (a q16 multiple, 65536 the normal speed), in ms of the listener's time: (length - pos) * 65536 / rate, an exact reduced rational, never rounded (a view shows its floor); length 0..359999999 (under 100 hours), pos 0..length and rate 32768..196608 (half to three times), else refused (Trebago refuses, KRON divides as it is: held)
the chapter playing at a position pos (ms): the number of chapter starts at or before pos, so 1 is the first chapter and 0 is before it; the starts ascending, the first 0, at most 64 (KRON)
whether a playing speed rate (a q16 multiple of the normal speed, 65536) is inside its limits: 32768..196608, half to three times; anything else refused, never brought inside silently (Eve)

where an episode or book is heard to fits ^ZXFIREGLOW(show, episode): show 0..31, episode 0..127, pos and length 0..359999999 ms (length 0 not known yet) and heard (ms listened in all) 0..9999999999; MYRA's digits (i2, i3, i9, i9, i10, sign aside) hold more, so a value inside them and outside these is held (MYRA TRUE, Eve FALSE); pos past a known length is the model's to refuse

how long a caption (a subtitle, a live caption, any timed line of text) stays on screen at least, in milliseconds: max(1000, 60 * chars), chars its characters 0..9999; a negative count or one past 9999 is refused (Sutra's 9(4) refuses, KRON answers: held)

the pace a caption has been read at: the whole milliseconds each of its characters has had on screen, floor(shown / chars), shown 0..999999999 ms and chars 1..9999; no characters is no pace (refused), and a value past its picture or negative is held (Sutra refuses, KRON answers)

whether a caption has stayed long enough to leave the screen, each field against its own range: shown 1000..999999999 ms, pace (caption_reading_pace) 60..999999999 ms a character, lines 1..2 and its longest line 1..42 characters; pace >= 60 is shown >= 60 * chars exactly
a saved caption fits its ^ZXTICKER record: at (ms since 1970) at most 15 digits, speaker 3, lang (its place in xlate.languages, 0 not known) 3 and chars 4, each sign aside

how far a survey traverse is inside its closure tolerance, one traverse a row: (tol * perim)^2 - 10000 * (dx^2 + dy^2), dx and dy the misclosure east and north in mm (-999999..999999), perim the perimeter in whole metres (1..99999) and tol the tolerance in mm per 100 m (0..9999); 0 or more exactly when the closure error sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2) is at most tol * perim / 100 mm, no root taken, exact; anything outside the domain held (Trebago refuses, KRON answers)

whether a survey traverse closes within tolerance, given as its traverse_closure_slack: closed when the slack is 0..999999999999999999, not closed below 0; a slack past 18 digits is no measurement and is held (Eve refuses, KRON reads any slack at or above 0 as closed)

a land title register line as a fixed business record: title number 9(9), parcel 9(6) and area in square metres 9(12), each 1 or more; a negative or longer value refused outright (Sutra's pictures); advisory, legal title is the land registry's

one claim a row, a grid cell (cx, cy) and the parcel claiming it: row i's count of rows that claim its cell for another parcel; 0 a cell held alone, more a disputed cell (BOTH: every claim kept, none overwritten, a person settles it)
a survey corner fits its ^ZXCHAIN(survey, parcel, corner) = x ^ y record: survey and parcel at most 6 digits, corner 4, x and y (mm east and north on the survey grid) 7, each sign aside

whether a sensor's reading is taken: inside the sensor's range lo..hi and no further than its step limit from its last accepted reading, as four margins each 0..999999: above (reading - lo), below (hi - reading), rise (step - (reading - last)) and fall (step - (last - reading)), a first reading's rise and fall the step itself; a range at most 999999 wide and a step 0..499999; a margin past 999999 is held (Eve refuses, KRON reads any margin at or above 0 as inside)

a short advisory outlook from the 3-hour pressure tendency and the pressure now, both in tenths of a hPa: 1 storm likely (tendency at or below -60), 2 rain likely (-59..-16), 6 improving (16..59), 7 clearing and windy (60 or more), and when steady (-15..15) 3 unsettled below 10000, 4 no change 10000..10199, 5 fair at or above 10200; tendency -500..500 and pressure 8700..10850, else refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held); official warnings take precedence

row i's cell of the grid of stations by hours (hours since 1970): the highest reading of every row with its station and its hour, itself included; a reading at or below -999999999999999999 (KRON's empty cell) refused

a weather station's observation fits its ^ZXISOBAR(station, stamp, kind) record: station at most 4 digits, stamp (seconds since 1970) 11, kind 1 (1 air temperature, 2 pressure, 3 humidity, 4 wind, 5 rain), reading (tenths of its unit) 7 and state 1 (0 accepted, 1 refused and kept), each sign aside

a node of a weather network's site tree fits ^ZXISOSITE(parent, site): parent (0 for a network, the root) and site at most 4 digits, kind 1 (1 a network, 2 a site that holds stations) and elev (metres) 5, each sign aside

whether the companion (swarm.ask) may read one of the owner's files: a live leave given (leave = 1: the owner gave it, did not revoke it, and now is from when it was given up to, not including, when it expires) AND the file's folder granted by it (granted = 1: the file is the leave's folder or under it) AND the file not from a more private space than the leave reaches (room = the file's space kind minus the leave's reach, kinds home 0 < office 1 < team 2 < cloudtop 3 < park 4 as zxv_spaces.h S3 orders a crossing, 0..4); a flag that is no flag (not 0 or 1) is never read as yes (Eve refuses it, KRON reads above 0 as yes: held); advice only, a leave is the owner's act and the answer is held until the owner accepts it

whether a debugger may attach to a program: it is the owner's own (own 1), the owner approved this attach (approved 1) and it is not a system process (system 0); each flag 0 or 1, any other value is no flag and the answer is no (Eve FALSE, KRON reads above 0 as yes: held)

whether a line is one of a file's breakpoint lines: 1 hit, 0 not; the breakpoints sorted and each once (strictly rising), each line 1..9999999, at most 256, one line a call; anything else refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)
the instructions a debugging session ran, one count for each step taken, summed exactly from the first step; a negative count or a sum past int64 refused, never wrapped
a debugging session inside its limits, each against its own range: breakpoints 0..256 and a stack view of 0..64 frames

a breakpoint fits its ^ZXBREAK(file, line) record: file (its place among the files opened) at most 2 digits, line 7, condition (the hits to pass before it stops, 0 every time) 9 and hits 9, sign aside

a claim has a source: cite (the citation number it names, 0 none) is 1..9999 and held (how many held citations carry that number, witness.kind_count over the numbers) is exactly 1; held 2 or more (one number on two citations) is held (Eve refuses, KRON answers: BOTH) for a person
a summary asked of the companion fits its limits: words (the length asked) 25..500 and sources (the held sources it draws on) 1..32, each held to its own range

a held citation fits ^ZXQUARRY(cite): cite (its number) at most 4 digits, topic 3, kind 1 (1 a Hoard file, 2 a Web4 envelope), stamp 12 (seconds since 1970) and quote (bytes of its excerpt) 5, sign aside

whether this node's seat may post in a space, each part given as its margin: roleroom (the most open role that may write in the space's kind, zxv_spaces.h S1: home and cloud top the owner, office and team members, a park the public; owner 0, member 1, guest 2, public 3; minus the seat's role) 0..3, lenleft (1024 - the post's bytes) and lenpast (the post's bytes - 1) each 0..1023, so a post is 1..1024 bytes (pspace.post); a margin past its meaning is held (Eve holds each to its range, MYRA reads each as a $H day 0..2980013)

the events applied in a space after index since: next - since, next the last index pspace.events answered (indexes 1, 2, ... in the order this node applied them), one space per row; since below 0, next below since or next past 18 digits (999999999999999999) is refused; more than 32 means some were missed (zxvd keeps the last 32)

the people across this node's public spaces: the exact sum of pspace.members' count of each space (this node included where it is in), one space per row, each 0..33 (32 members, vna_space.h VNA_SPACE_MEMBERS, and this node); a count outside refuses the whole sum

a public space this node is in or joining fits its ^ZXMEADOW record: space (its place in pspace.list) at most 1 digit, phase 1 (1 searching, 2 joining, 3 in, 4 not found), members 2, last (the last event index read) 18 and stamp (ms since 1970 of that event) 13, each sign aside

a line of a three-way merge in conflict: ours changed it, theirs changed it and the two changes are apart, each a flag exactly 1 (ours, theirs, apart); such a line is BOTH (lpres_kjoin of ours TRUE and theirs FALSE), both sides kept for the person to pick, never resolved by the app (Eve declares 1..1 for each, KRON reads above 0 as set: a flag of 2 is held)

a line of a three-way merge neither side changed: ours 0 and theirs 0, each a flag exactly 0; such a line is NEITHER and keeps the base line; every line neither untouched nor in conflict is TRUE (one side only, or the same change), and a file's merge is lpres_conjoin across the lines that changed (Eve declares 0..0 for each, KRON reads below 1 as clear: a flag of -1 is held)
lines a diff adds, exact: after - kept, after the newer file's lines and kept the lines both files keep in order (their common subsequence); refused unless 0 <= kept <= after <= 65536
lines a diff removes, exact: before - kept, before the older file's lines and kept the lines both files keep in order; refused unless 0 <= kept <= before <= 65536
whether a file may be compared line by line (a diff or a merge): bytes 0..16777216 (16 MiB) and lines 0..65536, each on its own range; a larger file is refused, never cut short

a commit of a folder's history fits ^ZXGRAFT(commit) = parent ^ author ^ stamp ^ msglen: commit and parent (0 for the first) at most 9 digits, author (a number, never a name) 6, stamp (seconds since 1970) 11 and message length in bytes 4, each sign aside; the history's links are witness.chain_ok

whether runs of one rule (in one pillar or several) are held as BOTH, each side kept for the person: a run said TRUE (sawtrue) and a run said FALSE (sawfalse), each a flag exactly 1; the knowledge join (lpres_kjoin) of the runs' verdicts is BOTH exactly then (Eve declares 1..1 for each, KRON reads above 0 as set: a flag of 2 is held)

the fuel left in a budget: fuelmax - spent, each 0..999999999999999999 (18 digits); spending past fuelmax is refused, never below zero (Sutra's 9(18) refuses a negative rest or a nineteen-digit value, KRON answers: held)

how many runs ran in one language pillar (want), exact, one total for the whole vector; each run's pillar 0..5 (0 a Lingua language, 1 Sutra, 2 Trebago, 3 Eve, 4 KRON, 5 MYRA), any other refuses the whole count
the exact sum of the milliseconds of the runs in one language pillar (want), one total for the whole vector; each pillar 0..5 and each run 0..60000 ms, any other refuses the whole total

whether one Playground run stayed inside its limits: output 0..49152 bytes (zxvd's files.read read_max) and 0..60000 ms (a minute; zxvd sets no wall-clock limit on play.run), each field on its own range; past either the run is kept as over and its verdict not used

a language index entry fits ^ZXCOLONNADE(lang) = pillar: lang (its line among LANGUAGE_FIT.tsv's 108 languages) at most 3 places and pillar (0 Lingua, 1 Sutra, 2 Trebago, 3 Eve, 4 KRON, 5 MYRA, from the runtime column) 1, sign aside

the width of a picture of vidw by vidh pixels (a video, a photo, any aspect) fitted whole inside a window of winw by winh, its aspect kept: min(winw, floor(winh * vidw / vidh)); vidw and vidh 1..65535, winw and winh 0..65535, a side outside refused (C++ traps, KRON answers: held); its height is aspect_fit_height; a 16:9 slide or frame is a picture of vidw 16 by vidh 9 (Footlight); its bars are letterbox_bar

the height of a picture of vidw by vidh pixels fitted whole inside a window of winw by winh, its aspect kept: min(winh, floor(winw * vidh / vidw)); vidw and vidh 1..65535, winw and winh 0..65535, a side outside refused (C++ traps, KRON answers: held)

the frame a position of pos ms falls in, in a video of fnum / fden frames a second (30000/1001 for 29.97): pos * fnum / (1000 * fden) from the first frame, an exact reduced rational, never rounded (the frame shown is its floor); pos 0..359999999 (under 100 hours), fnum and fden 1..999999 each, else refused

whether a watch hall's playing rate (a q16 multiple of the normal speed, 65536) is one zxvd's hall keeps: 1..262144, up to four times (zxvd_pspace.c); anything else refused, never sent and never brought inside silently (Eve)

where a video was watched to fits ^ZXKINETOSCOPE(video) = pos ^ length ^ stamp: video (its place in the resume table) at most 4 digits, pos and length in ms 9 and stamp (seconds since 1970) 11, each sign aside; that pos is inside the length is the model's own check

whether a guest may join a gathering, each part given as its margin: listpos (the guest's place on the invite list counted from 0, -1 when not on it) 0..99 and seatroom (the seats left once the guest's party is seated: seats - going - party) 0..9999; a margin past its meaning is held (Eve holds each to its range, MYRA reads each as a $H day 0..2980013)
the seats left at a gathering, one per row: seats - going (the people coming), exact; refused outside 0 <= going <= seats <= 9999 (Trebago refuses, KRON subtracts: held)

the people coming to a gathering: the exact sum of each guest's party where the guest's answer is yes, one guest per row; answer 0 none yet, 1 yes, 2 no, 3 maybe, party 1..99 (the guest and who comes with them); a value outside refuses the whole sum (Trebago refuses, KRON adds only the yes rows: held); how many gave each answer is witness.kind_count

a gathering fits its ^ZXBONFIRE record: gathering (its place in the list) at most 3 digits, start (seconds since 1970) 11, seats 4, going 4 and venue (its place in place.list, -1 for none) 3, each sign aside

a line of a gathering's invite list fits its ^ZXBONFIREINV(gathering, guest) record: gathering and guest (its place on the list) at most 3 digits each, answer 1 (0 none yet, 1 yes, 2 no, 3 maybe), party 2 and stamp (ms since 1970, when the answer came) 13, each sign aside

the stock of a product after a sale, in whole units: stock - sold, stock 0..999999999 (Sutra's 9(9)) and sold 1..stock; a sale of more than the stock is refused, never cut to zero; a stock past 9(9) is held (Sutra refuses, KRON answers)

a price from a cost and a margin over it, in integer minor units: cost * (mden + mnum) / mden rounded half up to a whole minor unit, floor((2 * cost * (mden + mnum) + mden) / (2 * mden)); cost 0..999999999, mnum 0..99999 and mden 1..99999 (25 / 100 is 25% over cost); a cost past 9(9) is held (Sutra refuses, Trebago answers to 12 digits)

whether a sale may go on a customer's credit: their balance plus the sale at most the limit they declared, as the margin room = limit - balance - sale (coffer.balance): sale 1..9007199254740991 minor units (2^53 - 1), limit 0..9007199254740991 and room 0..999999999999999999; a field past 18 digits is held (Sutra refuses, Eve says no)
row i's cell of the grid of products by places (one count a row: product, place, units): the exact sum of the units of every row with its product and its place, itself included
a product of a shop's catalogue fits ^ZXMERCER(category, product) = price ^ stock: category at most 4 digits, product 6, price (minor units) 15 and stock (units) 9, sign aside

one part of a colour's HSL from its red, green and blue (0..255 each), to the nearest with a half up: part 3 lightness (200 (mx + mn) + 51) / 102 thousandths, mx and mn the largest and smallest channel; a grey (d = mx - mn = 0) has hue 0 and saturation 0; otherwise part 2 saturation (2000 d + den) / (2 den) thousandths, den = 255 - |mx + mn - 255|, and part 1 hue (2 y + d) / (2 d) mod 360 degrees, y = 360 d + 60 (g - b) when red is largest, 120 d + 60 (b - r) when green is, else 240 d + 60 (r - g); a channel outside 0..255 or a part outside 1..3 refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)

one channel of a colour from its hue (0..359 degrees), saturation and lightness (0..1000 thousandths each), CSS Color 4's form: a = s min(l, 1000 - l), k = (n + h) mod 360 with n 0 red (part 1), 240 green (part 2), 120 blue (part 3), t = max(-30, min(k - 90, 270 - k, 30)), q = 30000 l - a t, the channel (17 q + 1000000) / 2000000 rounded down (255 q / 30000000 to the nearest, a half up); anything outside its range refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)

a colour's relative luminance in millionths: floor((2126 R + 7152 G + 722 B) / 10000), R G B each channel's linear light in millionths from the 256-value sRGB table (IEC 61966-2-1, rounded to the nearest millionth once, dyer_rules.h); a channel outside 0..255 refused by both languages

the contrast ratio of two colours x100 from their relative luminances in millionths (0..1000000, either the lighter): floor(100 (lighter + 50000) / (darker + 50000)), 100 for one colour on itself to 2100 for white on black; a luminance outside 0..1000000 refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)

the pass marks a contrast ratio x100 meets: 2 at 450 or more (body text), 1 at 300 to 449 (large text and parts of the screen only), 0 below 300; a ratio outside 100..2100, which no two colours make, refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)

a swatch of a palette fits: place 0..63 and colour 0..16777215 (0xRRGGBB), each in its own range (Eve); the ^ZXDYER record (MYRA) holds place in 2 digits and colour in 8, sign aside, so a value past its range inside its digits is held

whether a machine part's reading is inside its safe operating limits lo..hi for one measure, as two margins each 0..999999: above (reading - lo) and below (hi - reading); FALSE is a fault; a margin past 999999 is held (Eve refuses, KRON reads any margin at or above 0 as inside); a part's measures are joined with lpres_kjoin, so a part inside on one measure and outside on another is BOTH and inspected, never passed as sound

the next step of a machine repair from four check results (flags 0 or 1), the first that applies: 0 none (fault 0), 1 isolate the power (not isolated, not fixed), 2 repair or replace the part (isolated, not fixed), 3 restore the power and run the self-check (fixed, not tested), 4 record the repair and schedule the next service (fixed and tested); a flag that is not 0 or 1 is refused (BASIC refuses, KRON answers: held); advice only, one step at a time, each step that touches a machine begins with isolating the power and waits for the person's confirmation

a machine part's wear, exact: the sum over its run log of hours run times load share, in load-hours (10000 is one hour at full load); hours 0..99999 and load 0..10000 hundredths of a percent a row, any row outside refuses the sum

the hours a machine part has left to its next service at its load, an exact reduced fraction: (interval * 10000 - worn) / load, interval the full-load hours between services 1..999999, worn its wear since the last (machine_wear_load_hours, 0..999999999999999) and load 1..10000 hundredths of a percent; below 0 the service is past due by that many hours; anything outside refused

whether a key (to a door, a device or an account) opens now: issued (issued = 1) AND revoked on no device (revoked, the count of devices that say it is, = 0) AND not expired (left, its days left from lockbox.days_left, 1..3650); anything else is no, a flag that is no flag never read as yes (Eve holds each field to its range, KRON reads issued above 0, revoked below 1 and any left above 0: held); a key revoked on one device and active on another is BOTH (lpres_kjoin of the devices' words), locked out everywhere until the revocation reaches every device
whether a key's expiry is inside the limits: 1..3650 days after it is issued (ten years of 365 days); a key that never expires is not offered

whether a serial may enter a key register: serial > last (the last serial entered), so serials rise strictly and none is used twice; both 0..999999999 (Sutra's 9(9)), a serial past it (the register has overflowed) or a negative one refused, never wrapped or restarted

a key's entropy in whole bits from two lengths, never its bytes: floor(chars * lg / 1000), chars its length in symbols 0..4096, alphabet how many symbols it is drawn from 1..256, lg = floor(1000 * log2(alphabet)) from one integer table (the largest m with 2^m <= alphabet^1000); outside the domain refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)

row i's cell of the access grid, holders by doors or devices (one key a row: holder, item, live 0 or 1): the exact sum of live over every row with its holder and its item, itself included; how many live keys that holder has to that item

a key fits its holder tree's ^ZXWARD(holder, kind, item) = serial ^ expires record: holder and item at most 4 digits, kind 1 (1 a door, 2 a device, 3 an account), serial 9 and expires (seconds since 1970) 12, each sign aside; never a key's bytes

for each answer to one question, how many answers share its normalised code, itself included (witness.kind_count with each row's own code as want, every row at once); a code is 1..999999999 (0 is no answer) and any code outside refuses the whole vector (Trebago refuses, KRON counts it: held); all agree when every count is the number of answers

whether one more model may be asked, each cap as its margin (the owner's cap less what the question has spent less what the ask may spend): tokens 0..999999999, energy in microjoules and price in VFV minor units (before the assurance fee) each 0..999999999999999999; a margin below 0 is over a cap, one past its range is held (Eve refuses, KRON reads any margin at or above 0 as room)

an answer's confidence as an exact percent: 100 * agree / asked, a reduced fraction, never rounded (2 of 3 is 200/3); agree (the distinct models behind the answer) 0..asked and asked (models asked) 1..999999999, anything else refused
the answer matrix of models by answer codes, one answer a row (model, code): how many distinct models gave row i's code, each model counted once however often it answered so

a query's token cost entered at one denomination of swarm_denom.h: after = before + pieces * F(tier + 2) (D1 faces 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ...); tier 0..23 (PLAIN to RACING octane, faces 1..75025), before, pieces and after each 0..999999999999999999 (Sutra's 9(18)); a tier past 23, a negative or an after of 19 places refused, never wrapped
one source of an answer fits ^ZXTRIB(question, model) = code ^ stamp: question at most 9 places, model (its place among the sources asked) 2, code 9 and stamp (ms since 1970) 15, sign aside

whether a home circuit is within its breaker, as three margins each against its own range: spare = 4 * breaker - 5 * load in mA, 0..999999 (the load at most 80% of the breaker's rating), cable = cable rating - breaker rating in mA, 0..999999 (the cable rated at least the breaker), slack = the owner's drop limit - the voltage drop in microvolts, 0..999999999; FALSE is a circuit past its breaker; a margin past its range is held (Eve refuses, KRON reads any margin at or above 0 as within); advice only, a licensed electrician does the work

a load's current in milliamps from its watts and the supply's volts: 1000 * watts / volts, an exact reduced fraction (tally.ratio_div), never rounded; watts 0..999999 and volts 1..999, outside it held (Trebago refuses, KRON answers any volts but 0); rounded up to a whole mA where a whole current is needed, so a drop is never under-stated

a circuit's voltage drop in microvolts, out and back along its cable: 2 * metres * ma * mohm, metres the one-way length 0..9999, ma the current 0..999999 milliamps and mohm the conductor's milliohms a metre 0..99999, exact; outside the domain held (Trebago refuses, KRON answers)

where line `line` (0 the first) of a text starts, in bytes: the exact sum of the bytes of the lines before it, linebytes holding each line ended by a newline with the newline counted, 1..65537 each (a line of at most 65536 bytes and its newline), line 0..n (n the end of the last of them); a length or line outside the domain refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)

which line (0 the first) holds byte offset off of a text: how many of its newline-ended lines (linebytes, newline counted, 1..65537 each) end at or before off, the text after the last newline being the line after them; off 0..16777216; a length or offset outside the domain refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)

the byte offset of column col (0 the first, in characters) of one line: the exact sum of the UTF-8 widths (1..4 bytes each, one per character) of the characters before it, col 0..n (n the end of the line); a width that is no UTF-8 width or a column outside the line refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)

the column (0 the first, in characters) at byte offset off of one line, the inverse of utf8_column_offset: how many characters (UTF-8 widths 1..4 each) end at or before off, off on a character's boundary (0 or where one ends); an offset inside a character, past the line or negative, or a width that is no UTF-8 width, refused (Trebago refuses, KRON counts: held)

an edit buffer inside its limits: the file 0..16777216 bytes (16 MiB), its longest line 0..65536 bytes (its newline aside) and the undo history 0..1024 steps, each on its own range; a longest line past its file is no measurement (Eve holds each range alone, KRON also the line within its file: held)

one step of an editor's undo history fits ^ZXJOINERY(step) = offset ^ removed ^ inserted: step (its place in the history) at most 4 digits, the byte offset of the edit and the bytes it removed and inserted 8 each, sign aside

a suite's verdict over every result: each result's four-valued verdict (lpres.h: NEITHER 0, TRUE 1, FALSE 2, BOTH 3) conjoined with lpres_conjoin in the kernel's chain order F < N < B < T, so the lowest result wins (any FALSE is FALSE, else any NEITHER is NEITHER, else any BOTH is BOTH, else TRUE) and BOTH or NEITHER is never TRUE; one answer for the whole vector; a verdict outside 0..3 refused (Trebago refuses, KRON ranks it as FALSE: held); no result at all is NEITHER

whether a suite passed, the same rule as verdict_over_results being TRUE, over the counts of its results by verdict: passed 1..999999999 and failed, held (BOTH) and unknown (NEITHER) each exactly 0; a count past nine digits or below zero is held (Eve refuses it, KRON reads passed above 0 and the others below 1 as none)

a run's results counted: passed + failed + held, one run per row, each count 0..999999999 and the total too (Sutra's 9(9)); a negative count or a total past nine digits refused, never wrapped (Sutra refuses, KRON adds: held)

a suite's exact time: the sum of its runs' milliseconds, added from the first, each run 0..14400000 ms (a first try and three retries of at most an hour each); a run outside refuses the whole total, never wrapped

a build or test target's retry limits: 0..3 retries after the first try and a timeout of 1..3600 seconds for each try, each on its own range; only an undecided (NEITHER) try is retried, never a FALSE or a BOTH

a build or test run fits its ^ZXWHET(run) = target ^ verdict ^ passed ^ failed ^ held ^ ms record: run (its number in the session) at most 4 digits, target (its place in the plan) 3, verdict 1 (lpres.h code), passed, failed and held 9 each and ms 8, sign aside

where a node sits across on an integer ring about a centre: the ring at depth is the square of radius r = depth * step (every point at Chebyshev distance r), 8r units round, and the node order of count sits p = floor(order * 8r / count) units clockwise from the top-left corner (-r, -r), y down; x = p - r on the top side (p < 2r), r on the right (p < 4r), 5r - p on the bottom (p < 6r), -r on the left; exact, no trigonometry; depth 0..64, step 1..4096, count 1..65536 and order 0..count-1, anything else held (C++ traps, KRON answers)

where a node sits down on the same integer ring as square_ring_place_x (r = depth * step, p = floor(order * 8r / count) clockwise from (-r, -r), y down): -r on the top side (p < 2r), p - 3r on the right (p < 4r), r on the bottom (p < 6r), 7r - p on the left; the same domain, held outside it (C++ traps, KRON answers)

a mind map inside its limits, each field against its own range: nodes 1..512, depth (rings deep, the root 0) 0..15 and step (units between rings) 16..256; whether the deepest ring fits the canvas (2 * depth * step + 1 at most the shorter side of gesso.canvas_limits_ok's canvas) is the model's; a negative field or one past Sutra's picture (9(4), 9(3), 9(4)) is held (Sutra refuses, Eve answers false)

a mind-map node fits its ^ZXBRAMBLE(node) = parent ^ depth ^ order ^ x ^ y record: node, parent (-1 for the root) and order at most 3 digits, depth 2, x and y (units from the board's centre, y down) 4, each sign aside

what was spent in a budget category this month, in integer minor units: closing - opening of the category's holder account (its balance now less its balance when the month began), net of refunds, so below 0 when more came back than went in; opening and closing each 0..999999999999999999 (a holder is never below zero, 18 digits, Sutra's 9(18)), else refused (Sutra refuses a negative or nineteen-digit balance, Trebago answers: held)

whether a budget category is over its monthly budget: a budget is set (budget 1..999999999999999999 minor units; 0 is none, never over) and the excess spent - budget (balance_after) is 1..999999999999999999; each field held to its own range, so an excess past 18 digits is held (Eve says FALSE, Sutra refuses); advice only, nothing is moved

what a month's budget carries into the next: the exact sum over the categories of max(0, budget - spent) in integer minor units, so an overspent category carries nothing and takes nothing from the others; a budget below 0, a difference or a partial sum past 64 bits refused, never wrapped (Trebago)

whether an official record may be disposed of: its retention period is over (left, cartulary.retention_left of its date and its series' schedule, 0 or fewer, down to -9999999, Sutra's s9(7)) AND no legal hold is on it (hold 0: a hold always wins) AND the records officer approved (approved 1); each held to its own range, a left below -9999999 held (Eve refuses, KRON answers); advice only: the owner confirms, the record goes to the Trash and nothing is erased

the days a backlog takes to clear at the pace of the last n days: backlog * n / (sum cleared - sum arrived), an exact reduced fraction, never rounded; n 1..366 days, each day's arrived and cleared 0..999999, backlog 0..999999999; refused when the backlog does not fall (cleared no more than arrived)

an official record's register number in a register kept by the year: year * 1000000 + seq, year 0..9999 and seq (its place in that year's register, tallystick.next_doc_number of the year's last, from 1) 1..999999; a year's register past 999999 records refused, never wrapped; seq 0 is no register number (Sutra's picture holds it, ALGOL 60 refuses: held)

a record of a case file fits ^ZXSILT(series, caseno, doc) = regno ^ dated ^ hold: series at most 4 places, caseno 6, doc 4, regno 10 (yearly_register_number), dated (days since 1970) 6 and hold 1, sign aside

whether one band of a hearing device may play: its gain -300..300 tenths of a dB (a cut or boost of at most 30 dB), the level it would play (total) and the owner's cap each 0..1200 tenths of a dB SPL (120 dB SPL), and total at most cap; advisory, not a clinical fitting; only the owner moves the cap, and a gain past it is refused, never turned down silently (Eve holds each range alone, KRON also the cap: a level past the cap is held)
a balance between the ears and mono inside their limits, each against its own range: balance -100 (all to the left) .. 100 (all to the right), 0 even, and mono 0 (stereo) or 1 (one mix to both ears)

a sound alert's pattern fits ^ZXCONCH(sound) = flash ^ vibrate: sound kind 1..5 (call, message, alarm, task, other), flash and vibrate 0..3 pulses each, 334 ms apart, so a screen never flashes more than three times a second; MYRA's one digit each (sign aside) holds more, so 4..9 pulses or a kind the app does not have is held (MYRA TRUE, Eve FALSE)

where a capture region (a screenshot or a recording) starts along one side of the screen, clamped to it: min(max(pos, 0), span), never negative and never past the side; pos -99999..99999 pixels and span (the screen's side) 1..16384, anything else refused (Trebago refuses, KRON clamps: held); the region's extent along that side is hollow.shown

the exact raw size of a screen or video recording: w * h * bpp * secs * fps bytes, w and h 1..16384 pixels, bpp 1..8 bytes a pixel, secs 1..7200 (two hours) and fps 1..60, when it is at most room (0..999999999999999999 bytes, the room sys.disk reports less the owner's floor), else -1; an input past its range is refused (Trebago refuses, KRON multiplies it out: held)

the smallest whole number N of 1 or more not among a vector of used numbers (any order, repeats allowed; a number below 1 holds no place, so one 0 is an empty list and answers 1), as a "Screenshot N" or any "Name N" a folder does not hold yet

whether a filing is taken onto a case's docket: made by a party to the case (party exactly 1) AND inside the deadline (left, response_days_left, 0..9999 days: 0 is the last day) AND within the procedural limits (pages 1..250, exhibits 0..99); each field on its own range, a flag that is no flag never read as yes; a left past 9999 days is no deadline a tribunal sets (Eve refuses, KRON reads only left >= 0: held); the tribunal still decides the case

days left to respond: deadline - today, both days since 1970, each 0..999999; 0 is the last day, below 0 the deadline has passed, never clamped; a day outside refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)

a filing's docket number: caseno * 10000 + seq, caseno 1..999999 and seq (its place on the case's docket, tallystick.next_doc_number of the docket's last, from 1, never reused) 1..9999; a docket past 9999 lines refused, never wrapped; case 0 or seq 0 names nothing (Sutra's pictures hold them, ALGOL 60 refuses: held)

the evidence matrix: one evidence item a row, the claim it bears on (1..9999) and what it says of it (says 0 silent, 1 supports, 2 contradicts); each row's answer is its claim's four-valued state in the kernel's codes (lpres.h): 1 when some item supports the claim plus 2 when some item contradicts it (0 NEITHER, 1 TRUE, 2 FALSE, 3 BOTH), exactly lpres_kjoin of the claim's items; two witnesses who place one event at two sites make it BOTH, both kept, never merged, held until a person rules

a line of a dispute case's docket fits ^ZXASSIZE(caseno, seq) = kind ^ party ^ filed ^ claim: caseno at most 6 digits, seq 4 (docket_number's), kind 1 (1 opened, 2 filing, 3 evidence, 4 hearing, 5 ruling, 6 annotation), party 2, filed (days since 1970) 6 and claim 4, sign aside

whether a proposed dose is within the limits a care plan declares (the person's clinician sets them, a carer enters them; advice only, never a dose decided or changed), given as three margins: dosegap (per-dose maximum less the dose) 0..999999999, daygap (daily maximum less the doses in the 24 hours up to it, itself counted) 0..99 and waitgap (minutes since the last dose less the minimum interval; no earlier dose is 999999999) 0..999999999, each field against its own range; a negative margin is a limit passed; a margin past its range is held (Eve FALSE, KRON TRUE)

dose_within_declared_limit as a number to count with: 1 when every margin is 0 or more, else 0; dosegap and waitgap -999999999..999999999 and daygap -999..99, else refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)

what an item used every day costs over a month, in integer minor units: price (a unit's price) * perday (units a day) * days (the month's days, solstice.month_days), exact; price 0..999999999 (Sutra's 9(9)), perday 0..999 (9(3)) and days 0..99 (9(2)), else held (Sutra refuses, Trebago answers to 64 bits); a negative value or a product past 64 bits refused by both

an entry of a care plan fits ^ZXPOULT(patient, kind, item, day, minute, carer) = value: patient at most 4 digits, kind 1 (1 symptom, 2 dose given, 3 vital reading), item 4, day (days since 1970) 6, minute (of the day) 4, carer 2 and value 9, sign aside; the carer is in the key, so two carers' entries for one minute are two nodes, both kept

whether a held AI suggestion (zxm.h M3) may be applied, each part given as its margin: accepted (the owner's accept) exactly 1, secondsleft (its expiry minus now) 1..86400 (no hold lasts longer than a day, the longest zxvd's web4.consent grants) and drift (the target's version now minus the version it was made against) exactly 0; anything else is no (Eve holds each margin to its range; KRON reads an accept above 0 as yes and any secondsleft above 0 as live: an accept of 2 or a hold past a day is held); advice only, applying is the owner's act

suggestion_may_apply as a number to count with: 1 when it may be applied, else 0; an accept that is no flag (not 0 or 1) or a secondsleft past 86400 is refused (C++ as WebAssembly traps, KRON answers: held); an expired hold or any drift is an ordinary 0

how many AI suggestions are still held for one app: the exact sum of each suggestion's pending flag (1 held, 0 not) over the rows whose app slot equals want (one value for the whole vector); a flag that is no flag is held (KRON holds it inside 0..1, Trebago adds it as it is)

the limits of a held AI suggestion, each field against its own range: source 0..2 (0 a swarm.ask answer, 1 a play.draft draft, 2 a Web4 envelope held for consent), ttl 1..86400 seconds (no longer than a day, as web4.consent grants) and made 0..253402300799 (seconds since 1970, to the last second of 9999)

a held AI suggestion fits its ^ZXSIEVE(id) = app ^ source ^ state ^ expires ^ version record, sign aside: id at most 10 digits, app 3, source 1, state 1 (1 pending, 2 accepted, 3 rejected, 4 applied), expires 12 (seconds since 1970) and version 18
